items.source: In contrast to the JDK-based ResourceBundleMessageSource, this class uses Properties instances as its custom data structure for messages, loading them via a PropertiesPersister strategy from Spring Resource handles. This strategy is not only capable of reloading files based on timestamp changes, but also of loading properties files with a specific character encoding. It will detect XML property files as well.
items.translation: 与基于 JDK 的 ResourceBundleMessageSource 不同，该类使用 Properties 实例作为其消息的自定义数据结构，并通过 Spring Resource 句柄加载来自 PropertiesPersister 策略的消息。该策略不仅能够根据时间戳变化重新加载文件，还能够加载具有特定字符编码的属性文件。它也能检测 XML 属性文件。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to the configured ResourceLoader to resolve resources, checking in order for existing Resource with extensions defined by setFileExtensions(List) (.properties and .xml by default).
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给已配置的ResourceLoader 来解析资源，并依次检查是否存在由setFileExtensions(List)定义的扩展名（默认为.properties和.xml）的现有Resource。

items.source: As an alternative to overriding this method, you can configure a PropertiesPersister that is capable of dealing with all resources returned by this method. Please note, however, that the default loadProperties() implementation uses loadFromXml for XML resources and otherwise uses the two load methods for other types of resources.
items.translation: 作为覆盖此方法的替代方案，您可以配置一个能够处理此方法返回的所有资源的 `PropertiesPersister`。请注意，默认的 `loadProperties()` 实现对于 XML 资源使用 `loadFromXml`，而对于其他类型的资源则使用两个 `load` 方法。

items.source: If no suitable concrete Resource can be resolved, this method returns a Resource for which Resource.exists() returns false, which gets subsequently ignored.
items.translation: 如果无法解析到合适的具体`Resource`，此方法将返回一个使Resource.exists()返回false的`Resource`，该资源随后将被忽略。

items.source: When overriding this method, loadProperties(Resource, String) must be capable of loading properties from any type of Resource returned by this method. As a consequence, implementors are strongly encouraged to also override loadProperties().
items.translation: 当重写此方法时，loadProperties(Resource, String)必须能够加载由本方法返回的任何类型Resource的属性。因此，实现者强烈建议同时重写loadProperties()。

items.source: Note that the basenames set as "basenames" property are treated in a slightly different fashion than the "basenames" property of ResourceBundleMessageSource. It follows the basic ResourceBundle rule of not specifying file extension or language codes, but can refer to any Spring resource location (instead of being restricted to classpath resources). With a "classpath:" prefix, resources can still be loaded from the classpath, but "cacheSeconds" values other than "-1" (caching forever) might not work reliably in this case.
items.translation: 请注意，设置为 "basenames" 属性的基名与 ResourceBundleMessageSource 的 "basenames" 属性处理方式略有不同。它遵循基本的 ResourceBundle 规则，即不指定文件扩展名或语言代码，但可以引用任何 Spring 资源位置（而不是仅限于类路径资源）。使用 "classpath:" 前缀时，资源仍可从类路径加载，但在这种情况下，除了 "-1"（永久缓存）之外的其他 "cacheSeconds" 值可能无法可靠工作。

items.source: This MessageSource can easily be used outside an ApplicationContext: it will use a DefaultResourceLoader as default, simply getting overridden with the ApplicationContext's resource loader if running in a context. It does not have any other specific dependencies.
items.translation: 此 MessageSource 可轻松在 ApplicationContext 之外使用：它将默认使用 DefaultResourceLoader，如果在上下文中运行，则会被 ApplicationContext 的资源加载器简单覆盖。它没有其他特定依赖项。

items.source: Allows for returning a custom Properties extension in subclasses. Overriding methods should just instantiate a custom Properties subclass, with no further initialization or population to be performed at that point.
items.translation: 允许在子类中返回自定义的 Properties 扩展。 重写方法只需实例化一个自定义的 Properties 子类， 此时无需进行进一步的初始化或填充。

items.source: For a typical web application, message files could be placed in WEB-INF: for example, a "WEB-INF/messages" basename would find a "WEB-INF/messages.properties", "WEB-INF/messages_en.properties" etc arrangement as well as "WEB-INF/messages.xml", "WEB-INF/messages_en.xml" etc. Note that message definitions in a previous resource bundle will override ones in a later bundle, due to sequential lookup.
items.translation: 对于典型的 Web 应用程序，消息文件可以放置在 `WEB-INF` 中：例如，以 "WEB-INF/messages" 为基本名称可以找到 "WEB-INF/messages.properties"、"WEB-INF/messages_en.properties" 等排列方式，以及 "WEB-INF/messages.xml"、"WEB-INF/messages_en.xml" 等。请注意，由于顺序查找，之前 资源包中的消息定义将覆盖后续资源包中的定义。

items.source: The default is a list containing .properties and .xml.
items.translation: 默认值是一个包含.properties和.xml的列表。

items.source: Follows the rules defined by Locale.toString().
items.translation: 遵循由Locale.toString()定义的规则。

items.source: The default is DefaultPropertiesPersister.
items.translation: 默认值为DefaultPropertiesPersister。

items.source: The holder can be null if not cached before, or a timed-out cache entry (potentially getting re-validated against the current last-modified timestamp).
items.translation: 如果之前未缓存，则持有者可以为`null`，或者是一个已过期的缓存条目（可能需要根据当前的最后修改时间戳重新验证）。

Default is "true", minimizing contention between threads. If you prefer
the old behavior, i.e. to fully block on refresh, switch this flag to "false".
items.translation: 默认为"true"，以最小化线程间的竞争。如果您更喜欢旧的行为，即在刷新时完全阻塞，请将此标志切换为"false"。

items.source:
The default is a DefaultResourceLoader. Will get overridden by the
ApplicationContext if running in a context, as it implements the
ResourceLoaderAware interface. Can be manually overridden when
running outside an ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 默认值为 DefaultResourceLoader。如果在上下文中运行，它将被 ApplicationContext 覆盖，因为它实现了 ResourceLoaderAware 接口。在 ApplicationContext 外部运行时，可以手动覆盖它。

items.source:
Only used when caching resource bundle contents forever, i.e.
with cacheSeconds < 0. Therefore, merged properties are always
cached forever.
items.translation: 仅在永久缓存资源包内容时（即 `cacheSeconds` < 0）使用。因此，合并的属性始终被永久缓存。

properties from alternative sources — for example, from an XML BLOB
